# Gate 2 package - BI-PF-1553
**Next-Gen Web Console Packaging Specification: embed pre-compiled SPA distribution assets into Go platform server binary**

## Plain language
**What/why:** Product Forge web console and dashboard assets must be securely bundled and served directly by the platform binary without shipping exposed web source files or running Node.js at runtime. -> Next-Gen Web Console Packaging Specification: embed pre-compiled SPA distribution assets into Go platform server binary.

## Gate 2.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 2.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=94d5a820b673)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 16 (BLOCKER 2 / MAJOR 5 / MINOR 7 / NIT 2); dispositions: actioned 16; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLOCKER | AC-1 disposition "ACTIONED" unsupported: delta `compile_web_console` still only copies + SHA256-hashes inputs; no SPA compile/minify/optimization step exists anywhere in the candidate (no vite/npm/build invocation) → runtime: the "compiles SPA frontend into optimized assets" contract never executes; packages ship unoptimized copies. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 2 | BLOCKER | AC-2 disposition "ACTIONED" unsupported: embedded `go/web/dist` is a hand-written placeholder (`console.log("Product Forge Web Console Initialized")`, static index.html), not compiled frontend, and no step wires `compile_web_console` output into `go/web/dist` (config contract declares `dist/console`) → shipped binary serves a placeholder page; the console is non-functional in production. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 3 | MAJOR | Scope violation: delta edits many files outside declared `affected_files` (AGENTS.md, `scripts/dev/{design_precheck,item_kickoff,item_closeout,session_state,reconciliation_check,recurring_findings_check}.py`, `backlog_api.py`, `gate1_check.py`, `precheck.py`, `architect_review.py`) → unrelated tooling ships under this item unreviewed against its own design, violating AGENTS.md hard-stop rule 3 that this same diff introduces. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 4 | MAJOR | `design_precheck.py` hardcodes credential literal `pf-edp-local-token-32-chars-long` and force-writes it into `PF_API_TOKEN`/`PF_ADMIN_TOKEN` → a known token is committed and injected into the auth env, violating CL-005/token registry separation. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 5 | MAJOR | `backlog_api._token()` lets `PF_ADMIN_TOKEN` override `PF_API_TOKEN` for control-plane calls → wrong-privilege token used on the API surface; breaks the env-flags contract that `PF_API_TOKEN` is the canonical auth env and admin/EDP tokens are distinct. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 6 | MAJOR | Content-hash renaming rewrites references only in `index.html`; references inside CSS/JS (fonts, dynamic-import chunks, `url(...)`) keep old filenames → 404s on every intra-bundle asset once a real SPA (per design) is built; AC-1 hashing corrupts the bundle. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 7 | MAJOR | Delta `compile_web_console` calls `re.search(...)` but the hunk adds no `import re` → if the module lacks it, AC-1 build raises `NameError` and the packaging pipeline fails (verify module imports). | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 8 | MINOR | Fail-closed `fs.WalkDir` in `VerifyAssetIntegrity` also applies to the `PF_CONSOLE_STATIC_DIR` external dir → any stray file (`.DS_Store`, editor backup) blocks startup, removing the documented rollback path during an incident. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 9 | MINOR | `//go:embed dist/*` excludes dotfiles while `compile_web_console` copies+manifests them → a `.DS_Store` in dist is listed but not embedded, so embedded verification fails closed and the server refuses to boot. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 10 | MINOR | `asset_renames` uses plain `str.replace` with keys that prefix one another (`assets/app.js` vs `assets/app.js.map`) → reference corruption for nested-suffix asset names. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 11 | MINOR | Hash-skip heuristic `[-.][a-f0-9]{6,}` treats names like `vendor-012345.js` as pre-hashed → not renamed at build yet served `immutable` for a year (same pattern in Go `isContentHashedAsset`) → stale cache on external-dir rollback assets. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 12 | MINOR | Dispositions wrong: "clean `output_dist_dir`" and "wire `SkipGzipCompressed`" are marked ACTIONED, but the delta contains neither (the new test even asserts `shouldGzip := acceptsGzip && !isPrecompressedType(filename)` with no `SkipGzipCompressed`) → prior findings not actually resolved. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 13 | MINOR | `design_precheck._get_item` swallows all exceptions and returns `{}` → if the backlog API is unreachable the deterministic precheck passes vacuously (fail-open gate). | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 14 | MINOR | Disposition "ACTIONED (PF_ROOT anchoring)" incomplete: delta test `test_go_embedded_server_uncompressed_client` still uses CWD-relative `Path("go/web/console.go")`. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 15 | NIT | AGENTS.md protocol links `docs/BACKLOG-EXECUTION-QUICKREF.md` (not in diff) — confirm it exists or the new hard-stop rules point at a dead reference. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |
| 16 | NIT | `NewEmbeddedConsoleHandler(cfg ...ConsoleConfig)` silently ignores extra variadic configs; a fixed single-arg signature would be less error-prone. | ACTIONED | (no response yet) |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Delta genuinely fixes the embed directive, fail-closed integrity, and cache-header discrimination, but both prior AC dispositions overstate the fix: AC-1 has no compilation step and AC-2 embeds a placeholder dist, so the shipped console is not a real compiled SPA and no build→embed wiring exists.
  Top risks: placeholder production assets, scope creep shipping unreviewed tooling with a hardcoded token, and content-hash renaming that only rewrites index.html.
